Therefore, class conformance is high despite minor occlusion issues.

This suggests the AI struggled to render the complex interaction of hands gripping the bat during a swing. The jersey text/logos show warping (Severity 2.5). These structural and texture defects lower the artifact score significantly below the reference 'mid' quality image.
